mapper.select: SELECT set_config('app.tenant_id', CAST(#{tenantId} AS text), true)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tenant_announcement (id, tenant_id, title, body, sub_app, route, expires_at, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{title}, #{body}, #{subApp}, #{route}, #{expiresAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{actor}, #{actor})
mapper.select: SELECT visible.*, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM announcement_read r WHERE r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND r.membership_id = #{membershipId} AND r.announcement_id = visible.id AND NOT r.deleted) AS read FROM ( SELECT a.id, 'tenant' AS source, a.title, a.body, a.sub_app, a.route, a.expires_at, a.created_at AS published_at, a.revoked FROM tenant_announcement a WHERE a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND NOT a.deleted AND NOT a.revoked AND (a.expires_at IS NULL OR a.expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) UNION ALL SELECT a.id, 'platform' AS source, a.title, a.body, a.sub_app, a.route, a.expires_at, a.created_at AS published_at, a.revoked FROM platform_announcement a WHERE NOT a.deleted AND NOT a.revoked AND (a.expires_at IS NULL OR a.expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND (a.all_tenants OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM platform_announcement_target t WHERE t.announcement_id = a.id AND t.tenant_id = #{tenantId})) ) visible ORDER BY visible.published_at DESC, visible.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO announcement_read (id, tenant_id, membership_id, announcement_id, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{membershipId}, #{announcementId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{actor}, #{actor}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, membership_id, announcement_id) WHERE NOT deleted DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO platform_announcement (id, title, body, sub_app, route, expires_at, all_tenants, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{title}, #{body}, #{subApp}, #{route}, #{expiresAt}, #{allTenants}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{actor}, #{actor})
INSERT INTO platform_announcement_target (announcement_id, tenant_id) VALUES (#{announcementId}, #{tenantId}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT id, title, body, sub_app, route, expires_at, created_at AS published_at, revoked, all_tenants FROM platform_announcement WHERE NOT deleted ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
SELECT tenant_id FROM platform_announcement_target WHERE announcement_id = #{id} ORDER BY tenant_id

SELECT id, 'tenant' AS source, title, body, sub_app, route, expires_at, created_at AS published_at, revoked, false AS read FROM tenant_announcement WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND NOT deleted ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE tenant_announcement SET revoked = true, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{actor} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND NOT deleted AND NOT revoked
UPDATE platform_announcement SET revoked = true, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{actor} WHERE id = #{id} AND NOT deleted AND NOT revoked
UPDATE tenant_announcement SET deleted = true, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = NULL WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND NOT deleted
UPDATE announcement_read SET deleted = true, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = NULL WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND NOT deleted
